newsitem.title: USA: 1.89 mln Stratford shares may be illegal.
newsitem.headline: 1.89 mln Stratford shares may be illegal.

text.p: Stratford Acquisitions Corp said Thursday that an ongoing review of historical corporate records has identified 1,885,600 shares that may have been issued unlawfully and may be subject to cancellation.

The shares in question, said the company, represent 18 percent of its outstanding stock. Stratford said that it expects to make a final determination on or about April 30. The company said it has notified affected shareholders of the possibility that their shares may be cancelled.

The company also said that that it has received amended audited financial statements from its accountants for its fiscal year ended May 31, 1996. Stratford said that it has unaudited quarterly financial statements for the two following quarters ended August 31 and November 30, and plans to file amended 10K and two amended 10Q statements.
Stratford makes and sells an additive that enhances the performance of mortars used in new construction and in the repair of deteriorating concrete structures.
